results.title: Yet Another Indie Horror Film
results.overview: What was to be a fun filled weekend reminiscing about their high school days, three friends find themselves in a nightmare, stalked by a masked killer with no way to escape.

results.title: Hamilton House
results.overview: A home of struggling actors will stop at nothing to create a haunted house to catch the eye of their new neighbor, a legendary horror filmmaker.

results.title: Relatively Normal
results.overview: The film follows teenager Hannah Glass as she rides out pandemic lockdown under one roof with her family and learns that the real threat isn’t only what’s happening outside the house.

results.title: How to Live Without Going Crazy
California Schemin'
results.overview: After being ridiculed for their Scottish accents, two ambitious musicians reinvent themselves as American rappers and fool the British music industry into a lucrative record deal, only for their elaborate lie to unravel under the weight of instant fame.

results.title: Istanbul: Chronopolis
results.overview: Istanbul: Chronopolis is an experimental documentary that explores the city as a living organism where the linear flow of time is disrupted and the past and future coexist. Structured around a thematic cycle of birth, speed, and decay, the film uses rhythmic visuals and archival footage to bridge temporal gaps. Through a fourteen-minute mathematical edit, it replaces linguistic narrative with the evocative language of time-lapse and slow-motion cinematography. The project invites the audience to transcend chronological time and experience Istanbul as an eternal moment—an entity existing solely within its own timeless cycle.

results.title: Décima
results.overview: In 1980s Puerto Rico, a grieving man is torn between escaping with his pregnant wife or joining his radicalized younger brother in a dangerous fight for justice, as the death of their brother threatens to tear their family and community apart.

results.title: Matīss Kaža. The Impossible Self-Portrait
results.overview: The film follows Matīss Kaža during a period when his professional life has taken him from one country and continent to another. Together with Gints Zilbalodis, the director of the film Flow (Straume), he spent nearly a year caught in a whirlwind of international award ceremonies, events, and meetings—a journey that included the film’s path to the Academy Awards. Yet, this is only one facet of Kaža’s life and work. During the same period, he made his debut as a theatre director at three different venues in Riga and crafted the Lielais Kristaps (Latvian National Film Awards) and Spēlmaņu nakts (Latvian Theatre Awards) ceremonies as multimedia performances. The camera follows Kaža as he constantly creates, travels, and engages in new projects, all while maintaining an ironic perspective on both himself and the world around him.

results.title: The Way Through
results.overview: Italy, 2035. Mansfield, Stendhal and Buzzati are friends and partisans fighting against the regime. Engaged in relays of coded messages hidden in ciphered books, they are forced into a race against time: the fascists are about to take the town of Ovada.

results.title: Titans
results.overview: Small-time gangster Antony Yakuza teams up with young programmer Anwar to pull off a major heist, with mysterious driver Rejimon joining them. But Rejimon is not who he seems, and their simple crime soon turns into a strange, unpredictable journey where reality itself begins to blur.

results.title: Crocodile Dose
results.overview: On their first summer back from college, best  friends Curtis, Jimmy, and Abe embark on a fantastical 24-hour odyssey of drugs and alcohol on their way to a house party hosted by Curtis’s ex-girlfriend, Jane. When their pursuit of hedonism leads to Jane and Curtis reuniting prematurely, Curtis is unable to handle his emotions and  loses touch with his relationships and reality.

results.title: Vanished in an Instant
results.overview: After her daughter disappears from a gas station, a mother's race against time uncovers a chilling truth buried beneath a quiet town's surface.

results.title: Honey
results.overview: A broken family, a forbidden ritual, and a child trapped between reality and delusion. Honey exposes systemic abuse and spiritual madness, where the most terrifying monsters are painfully real.

results.title: S22
results.overview: Gero and Cris, two young filmmakers, have the opportunity to pitch their idea to an important producer. But minutes before, Gero receives a call from work demanding that he return immediately, forcing him to choose between securing his present or risking it all for his future.

results.title: Romare Bearden: A Life in Collage
results.original_title: Romare Bearden: A Life in Collage
results.overview: An athlete, artist, and activist, Romare Bearden defied boundaries placed on Black men of his generation. He partied with James Baldwin in Paris, composed hit songs, and channeled his memories into powerful collages celebrating Black life that changed contemporary art. He challenged social injustice and broke down barriers in art, culminating in a vibrant artistic legacy that inspires and empowers artists, dancers, and musicians.

results.title: Brawlers
results.overview: Naïm is a sweetheart in everyday life but a beast when it comes to fighting. To afford treatment for his aging dog, he's forced to join "Hello Brawl", a service of street fighters resolving conflicts with punches.

results.title: Summer Sparks
results.overview: Follows a single father and a single mom at Camp Evergreen during a summer cook-off, where cooking mishaps and heartfelt moments lead to an unexpected romantic connection.
